dict.string: Peripheral Glow Track 10: Square wave lead for the rising D-F-A motif. Use with AutoFilter (LFO 0.3Hz sine, 30% depth) and Stereo Delay (1/8 ping pong, 25% feedback, 20% wet).
Rising motif D-F-A climbing octaves: D3-D4-D5-D6. Velocity escalation: 30-50-75-100. Inverted on 2nd/4th appearances (A-F-D). Counter-melody E5-G5 range.
